title: Crispy Mexican Kale Bites
description: A keto recipe with crispy kale bites, perfect for a quick snack or side dish. The combination of spicy Mexican flavors and crunchy texture makes this dish addictive.

ingredients.name: bake
ingredients.notes: ground beef or chicken, seasoned with cumin and chili powder

instructions: Rip the kale leaves into bite-sized pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with a little oil and sprinkle with salt; toss to coat.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, until crispy.
Meanwhile, heat the Mexican seasoning blend in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef or chicken and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the crispy taco shells to the pan and stir to combine with the meat mixture.
Remove the kale from the oven and let cool slightly.
Use the kale as a base for the bites, topping each piece with a spoonful of the meat and shell mixture.
Drizzle with a little glazed sauce and serve immediately.
